migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged; 1.1.1 to 1.1.2: Clarified the public rubric wording and evidence descriptions. Scoring rules and pack fields are unchanged. 1.1.2 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. Measured release blockers override the numerical grade. The owner profile declares supported storage and recovery cases. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Adds case-level transaction blockers, recovery state comparisons, build and rollback receipts and separate reviewer decisions. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles no-store.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks. Each confirmed release blocker sets verdict BLOCKED and grade 0. Supported points, coverage and the evidence interval retain their uncapped values. Unmeasured safety evidence prevents PASS.
source: Transaction and recovery fixtures, service records and the project’s rights and privacy documentation.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

releaseBlockers.reason: A duplicate paid grant blocks release.
A measured entitlement shortfall after restore blocks release.
An accepted transaction replay blocks release.

no-store.reason: The game sells nothing; its 20 points are shared over the other lines and the payment blockers do not apply. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.
